question: Consider a container of the shape obtained by revolving a segment of the parabola $x=1+y^2$ around the $y$-axis as shown below. The container is initially empty. Water is poured at a constant rate of $1\text{ cm}^3/\text{s}$ into the container. Let $h(t)$ be the height of water inside the container at time $t$. Find the time $t$ when the rate of change of $h(t)$ is maximum.
